brief: I built a Claude Code research analyst that beat my $8K/mo consultant. Here's how.

slots.step1Title: Write a one paragraph analyst brief
slots.step1Sub: State exactly what decisions this research feeds.
slots.step2Title: List your non negotiable data sources
slots.step2Sub: Pick three core channels the consultant used.
slots.step3Title: Set output format and update cadence
slots.step3Sub: Weekly memo or live dashboard, choose one now.

slots.step1Title: Plug APIs into real time intel feeds
slots.step1Sub: Link news, financials, and LinkedIn via webhooks.
slots.step2Title: Sync CRM records for account context
slots.step2Sub: Map existing contacts to research targets instantly.
slots.step3Title: Add vector storage for long term memory
slots.step3Sub: Upload past reports so Claude learns your style.

slots.step1Title: Trigger daily scans across priority accounts
slots.step1Sub: Claude reads fifty sources before you wake up.
slots.step2Sub: Bullet key changes, risks, and opportunities clearly.
slots.step3Title: Score each lead by custom fit criteria
slots.step3Sub: Rank prospects so sales knows who to call.

slots.step1Title: Write a system prompt mimicking your consultant
slots.step1Sub: Mirror their tone, depth, and citation habits exactly.
slots.step2Title: Add reflection steps before final output
slots.step2Sub: Force Claude to check logic and fill gaps first.
slots.step3Title: Chain multiple Claude instances for review
slots.step3Sub: One researches, one edits, one finalizes the memo.

slots.step1Title: Cross check claims against primary sources
slots.step1Sub: Never trust a stat without a linked citation.
slots.step2Title: Run red team prompts to find weak assumptions
slots.step2Sub: Ask Claude to argue against its own conclusion.
slots.step3Title: Compare output with your old consultant work
slots.step3Sub: Match or beat their depth within thirty days.

slots.step1Title: Auto publish memos to Slack and email
slots.step1Sub: Your team sees research at nine every Monday.
slots.step2Title: Build a simple dashboard for live requests
slots.step2Sub: Stakeholders ask questions and get cited answers.
slots.step3Sub: Iterate instructions based on user feedback scores.

slots.body: I built the exact prompt stack and tool map so you can clone the $8K/mo system without the invoice.
